scope: Paired RTX 5090 optimization of the DINO-style ViT-g/14 synthetic systems proxy
claim_boundary: These jobs measure synthetic construction, forward, backward, optimizer, memory and throughput. They do not train on images and provide no representation-quality, convergence or model-superiority evidence.

available_snapshot_after_experiments.warning: Scheduler availability is a point-in-time snapshot and can change immediately.

selected_maximum_throughput_recipe.precision: BF16 compute with FP32 parameter shards, reductions and AdamW state

recommended_headroom_recipe.reason: It retains 1.916 GiB more reserved-memory headroom while giving up only 0.187% median synthetic throughput.

frontier.configuration: tensorwise FP8 for 161 eligible Linear layers per model, FP8 FSDP all-gather, BF16 attention
frontier.metric_boundary: This is a BF16-peak-equivalent useful-FLOP ratio, not FP8 MFU.

frontier.configuration: BF16 without activation checkpointing at batches 32, 30 and 28
BF16 checkpointing every second block at batches 44 and 40

xformers_paired_screen.reason: The installed xFormers 0.0.35 attention path was 31.8% slower than native PyTorch SDPA on the paired RTX 5090 shape.

research_decisions.torch_compile: Retain max-autotune-no-cudagraphs. Official PyTorch reports material MFU gains from torch.compile; this project already measures the compiled path.
research_decisions.float8: Keep the opt-in implementation for future hardware/runtime retesting, but reject it on the measured RTX 5090 stack. Official torchao guidance says tensorwise is fastest and integrates with compile/FSDP2, but also warns that shape and hardware determine gains.
research_decisions.xformers: Do not replace native SDPA in this runtime. A future faithful DINO multicrop implementation may separately test xFormers block-diagonal nested execution, because upstream DINOv2 uses xFormers for nested tensors.
research_decisions.activation_checkpointing: Keep checkpointing every block. Every tested reduced-checkpoint configuration exhausted 32GB memory before the first complete step.
research_decisions.batch: Use 112 per rank. Batch 116 and 128 crossed the throughput knee and produced lower or less stable throughput.

current_source.note: The current preflight source adds opt-in FP8 and checkpoint-frequency controls. Defaults preserve the selected BF16 full-checkpoint behavior.
